title: Dynamic portfolio selection under range value-at-risk with logarithmic returns
abstract: arXiv:2610.26919v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper studies continuous-time portfolio selection under Range Value-at-Risk (RVaR), with both portfolio performance and risk evaluated in terms of logarithmic returns. We formulate a mean--RVaR problem in a continuous-time financial market and reduce the dynamic optimization to a static quantile problem. Using quantile representation, Lagrangian optimization, and convexification, we characterize the optimal terminal wealth through the convex envelope of an RVaR-specific transformed weighting function.   The RVaR-specific convex envelope exhibits two distinct geometric configurations. Under Scenario~1, the terminal wealth has a VaR-type structure: the minimum-RVaR payoff is digital-option-like, whereas for $0<\lambda<1$ it consists of two growth-optimal regions separated by a constant-payoff region. translated_title: 基于区间风险价值与对数收益率的动态投资组合选择
translated_abstract: 本文研究了区间风险价值约束下的连续时间投资组合选择问题，其中投资组合的绩效与风险均以对数收益率来衡量。我们在连续时间金融市场中构建了均值-RVaR问题，并将动态优化问题约化为静态分位数问题。利用分位数表示、拉格朗日优化与凸化方法，我们通过一个RVaR特定的变换加权函数的凸包来刻画最优终端财富。该RVaR特定的凸包呈现出两种截然不同的几何构型。在情景1下，终端财富具有VaR型结构：最小RVaR的收益呈数字期权形式，而当$0<\lambda<1$时，最优终端财富由两个增长最优区域构成，中间被一个固定收益区域分隔。在情景2下，凸包由连接内部接触点与端点的支撑线确定，或者……
tldr: 本文研究了基于对数收益率的区间风险价值（RVaR）约束下的连续时间均值-RVaR投资组合选择问题，通过将动态优化约化为静态分位数问题，并借助RVaR特定的凸包刻画出最优终端财富的两种几何结构，即VaR型数字期权结构及由增长最优区域与固定收益区域组合的结构。
en_tdlr: This paper solves the continuous-time mean-RVaR portfolio selection problem with logarithmic returns by reducing the dynamic optimization to a static quantile problem and characterizing optimal terminal wealth via the convex envelope of an RVaR-specific transformed weighting function, which exhibits two distinct geometric configurations: a VaR-type digital-option structure and a structure combining growth-optimal regions with a constant-payoff region.
